lines.text: Hezekiah consulted his leaders, and many people stopped up all the springs and the stream that flowed through the land.
While Sennacherib besieged Damascus, his servants spoke against Hezekiah, and his letters mocked the LORD, saying no god delivered his people.
After Hezekiah and Isaiah prayed, the LORD sent an angel who annihilated the leaders in the king of Assyria's camp, and He saved Jerusalem.
